cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Argument Delimiters in a Command ('Argument Injection')

exact_cwe_mechanism.evidence: git clone command with user-controlled remoteUrl directly interpolated into shell command string without proper argument delimitation - exactly matches CWE-88 pattern of improper argument neutralization in command execution

connection.evidence: remoteUrl parameter flows directly from function input to git clone command execution via utils.run() -> child_process.exec()

diff_causality.evidence: This line is newly added (change_type: A) and introduces the vulnerable command interpolation pattern

security_control.evidence: No validation, sanitization, or parameterization of remoteUrl before shell interpolation
security_control.required_control: Argument validation and proper command parameterization
security_control.control_requirement_evidence: CWE-88 requires proper delimitation of arguments when constructing shell commands to prevent injection
existing_controls_checked: No input validation on remoteUrl parameter
No escaping or parameterization in command construction
git clean working directory check (unrelated to command injection)
security_control.deficiency_evidence: remoteUrl is directly interpolated into shell command string without any validation, escaping, or parameterized execution

concrete_impact.evidence: Successful argument injection could lead to arbitrary command execution with the privileges of the running process

diff_counterfactual: If the candidate line were reverted, the git clone command with vulnerable interpolation would not be executed, eliminating the argument injection vulnerability.
supporting_evidence: remoteUrl is a function parameter with user-controlled input
Direct string interpolation into git clone shell command
utils.run() uses child_process.exec() which executes via shell
No validation or sanitization of remoteUrl before command construction
unresolved_facts: Whether createCustomDiff parameter defaults to true or false
Exact validation controls in createCustomRemote function
review_comment: The git clone command directly interpolates user-controlled remoteUrl into the shell command without validation or parameterization, creating an argument injection vulnerability. Use parameterized command execution by passing arguments as an array to child_process.spawn() instead of string interpolation, or validate remoteUrl against a strict allowlist of safe URL patterns before execution.
